name: Hatsudai
tagline: Shinjuku in 11 minutes and Shibuya in 21 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Shibuya City, served by Keio Line and Keio New Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 36 minutes to Otemachi, 11 minutes to Shinjuku, 21 minutes to Shibuya and 42 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 41.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 11.2 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 41.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 30.3 m to 41.5 m, a difference of 11.2 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: 成城石井 オペラシティ店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 6 clinics and 6 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 温光会内藤病院, about 178 m away and 東洋病院, about 560 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Keio Line and Keio New Line. Both lines are run by Keio, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 52.

rentRange.note: One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000, 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000, 1LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000 and 2LDK ¥290,000 to ¥300,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Hatsudai, but Sangubashi is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: 714 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 10 minutes sooner than Hatsudai. One-room rents run about ¥13,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome is ahead on how close the centre is and quiet, but Hatsudai is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: 970 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 9 minutes sooner than Hatsudai.

goodFor: People who want a park close by
notFor: The data does not show a drawback particular to this station
noiseSources: The 首都高速4号新宿線 viaduct runs 4 m away. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
甲州街道 (2 lanes each way) runs 8 m away. Morning and evening, the cars are audible indoors

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make: 首都高速4号新宿線 runs 4 m away.
